name: Ray Filtering
aliases: Ray Filtering — Filtering Rays, Ray Culling, Ray Filtering Outside Bounding Box, TensorBase Ray Filtering
definition: Filters rays based on whether they intersect with the alpha mask or the AABB bounding box, reducing computation for rays that do not pass through the scene.
summary: Ray filtering reduces computational load by discarding rays that do not intersect the scene's geometry or alpha mask before volume rendering.
